recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source change is needed for FHIR-18017; any future desire for a stronger Financial Management-specific status code binding on Task output should be raised as a new current-scope change request.
issue_request: FHIR-18017 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to add ProcessResponse.processStatus as a 0..1 CodeableConcept with an extensible ProcessOutcomeCodes binding; the final resolution redirected the change to Task because ProcessResponse was deprecated, citing FHIR-19345.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-18017. The relevant application appears through the FHIR-19345/GF #19345 work: bbc5d920 added Financial Module Task guidance and Task status request/response examples, and 642e610a removed ProcessRequest and ProcessResponse from active resource metadata and annotated them as approved to use Task.
additional_context: FHIR-19345 is already represented on the combined branch by a fixed reconciliation commit. The companion FHIR-18022 processStatus code set request was Resolved - No Change because ProcessResponse was deprecated in favor of Task. Current Task.output.value[x] can carry CodeableConcept or code values, and the Financial status-response example shows Task.status=completed for the Task instance with a status output value for the referenced resource. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Adding processStatus to inactive ProcessResponse source would be out of current build scope, and adding a new Task element or binding would exceed the final Jira resolution because current Task output already carries the targeted resource status/outcome while Task.status carries the Task instance status.
